title: Parts of Speech and Word Formation — Level 8 — Arrange and transform

tags.kisi-kisi: Parts of Speech and Word Formation

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: "carefully / the / read / instructions / students / the"

visual.text: The students read the instructions carefully.

choices.say: The students read the instructions carefully.

visual.text: The students carefully the instructions read.

choices.say: The students carefully the instructions read.

visual.text: The instructions read the students carefully.

choices.say: The instructions read the students carefully.

visual.text: Carefully the read students the instructions.

choices.say: Carefully the read students the instructions.

items.reteach: Pola: Subject + Verb + Object + adverb of manner.

items.prompt: Rewrite "Rina decided quickly" using the noun "decision". Which is correct?

visual.text: Rina made a quick decision.

choices.say: Rina made a quick decision.

visual.text: Rina made a quickly decision.

choices.say: Rina made a quickly decision.

visual.text: Rina made a decide quickly.

choices.say: Rina made a decide quickly.

visual.text: Rina decisioned quickly.

choices.say: Rina decisioned quickly.

items.reteach: Noun "decision" diterangkan adjective (quick); kolokasinya "make a decision".

items.prompt: Transform "The guide explained the history clearly" into a sentence with the noun "explanation".

visual.text: The guide gave a clear explanation of the history.

choices.say: The guide gave a clear explanation of the history.

visual.text: The guide gave a clearly explanation of the history.

choices.say: The guide gave a clearly explanation of the history.

visual.text: The guide explanation the history clearly.

choices.say: The guide explanation the history clearly.

visual.text: The guide gave a clear explain of the history.

choices.say: The guide gave a clear explain of the history.

items.reteach: Adverb "clearly" menjadi adjective "clear" saat menerangkan noun "explanation".

items.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as "It is not possible to finish the bridge this year"?

visual.text: It is impossible to finish the bridge this year.

choices.say: It is impossible to finish the bridge this year.

visual.text: It is unpossible to finish the bridge this year.

choices.say: It is unpossible to finish the bridge this year.

visual.text: It is possibly to finish the bridge this year.

choices.say: It is possibly to finish the bridge this year.

visual.text: It is disposable to finish the bridge this year.

choices.say: It is disposable to finish the bridge this year.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "very / a / gave / speech / the / principal / inspiring"

visual.text: The principal gave a very inspiring speech.

choices.say: The principal gave a very inspiring speech.

visual.text: The principal gave a speech very inspiring.

choices.say: The principal gave a speech very inspiring.

visual.text: The principal gave very a inspiring speech.

choices.say: The principal gave very a inspiring speech.

visual.text: A very principal gave the inspiring speech.

choices.say: A very principal gave the inspiring speech.

items.reteach: Urutan frasa benda: article + adverb + adjective + noun (a very inspiring speech).

items.prompt: Rewrite "Dimas is a fast swimmer" using the verb "swim".

visual.text: Dimas swims fast.

choices.say: Dimas swims fast.

visual.text: Dimas swims fastly.

choices.say: Dimas swims fastly.

visual.text: Dimas swim fast.

choices.say: Dimas swim fast.

visual.text: Dimas is swim fastly.

choices.say: Dimas is swim fastly.

items.reteach: "Fast" sebagai adverb tetap "fast" (tidak ada "fastly"); subjek tunggal memakai "swims".

items.prompt: Change "The answer is correct" into the opposite meaning by adding a prefix.

visual.text: The answer is incorrect.

choices.say: The answer is incorrect.

visual.text: The answer is uncorrect.

choices.say: The answer is uncorrect.

visual.text: The answer is discorrect.

choices.say: The answer is discorrect.

visual.text: The answer is miscorrect.

choices.say: The answer is miscorrect.

items.reteach: Lawan kata correct memakai prefix in-: incorrect.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "beautifully / in / sang / the / Ayu / hall"

visual.text: Ayu sang beautifully in the hall.

choices.say: Ayu sang beautifully in the hall.

visual.text: Ayu beautifully sang the in hall.

choices.say: Ayu beautifully sang the in hall.

visual.text: In Ayu the hall sang beautifully.

choices.say: In Ayu the hall sang beautifully.

visual.text: Ayu sang in beautifully the hall.

choices.say: Ayu sang in beautifully the hall.

items.reteach: Pola: Subject + Verb + adverb of manner + keterangan tempat.

items.prompt: Rewrite "The tourists were amazed by the sunrise at Bromo" using the noun "amazement".

visual.text: The tourists watched the sunrise at Bromo in amazement.

choices.say: The tourists watched the sunrise at Bromo in amazement.

visual.text: The tourists amazement the sunrise at Bromo.

choices.say: The tourists amazement the sunrise at Bromo.

visual.text: The tourists watched the sunrise at Bromo in amazing.

choices.say: The tourists watched the sunrise at Bromo in amazing.

visual.text: The tourists were amazement by the sunrise at Bromo.

choices.say: The tourists were amazement by the sunrise at Bromo.

items.reteach: Noun dipakai setelah preposition: in amazement (dengan takjub).

items.prompt: Change "He speaks with confidence" into "He is a ___ speaker". Which sentence is correct?

visual.text: He is a confident speaker.

choices.say: He is a confident speaker.

visual.text: He is a confidently speaker.

choices.say: He is a confidently speaker.

visual.text: He is a confidence speaker.

choices.say: He is a confidence speaker.

visual.text: He is a confide speaker.

choices.say: He is a confide speaker.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "the / was / of / improvement / students / remarkable / the"

visual.text: The improvement of the students was remarkable.

choices.say: The improvement of the students was remarkable.

visual.text: The students of the improvement was remarkable.

choices.say: The students of the improvement was remarkable.

visual.text: Remarkable the improvement was of the students.

choices.say: Remarkable the improvement was of the students.

visual.text: The improvement was the students of remarkable.

choices.say: The improvement was the students of remarkable.

items.reteach: Subjek "The improvement of the students" + was + adjective "remarkable".

choices.say: The road is missafe at night.
